crm_notes:
- Prospect: Ledgerly (mid-market billing platform). Primary use: support agents handling billing/subscriptions (Stripe & Zuora). Wants streaming responses, reliable tool-calling to execute refunds, invoices, subscription changes. Needs structured JSON outputs for downstream systems.
- Latency target: p50 ~200-300ms, p95 <500ms for typical agent flows. Cost sensitive; wants hosted to start but exploring Dedicated for heavy volume and residency.
- POC: 2-week Hosted API; build 3 flows (refund, plan-change, invoice-reissue) with tool calling + schema-validated JSON. Success metrics: end-to-end latency, accuracy of parsed entities, % of successful tool calls, cost/token.
- Tech ask: streaming output with partial tool-call signals (function call + chunked JSON), KV cache for repeat user histories, webhook reliability. SE notes: need to validate Stripe keys handling via secrets API; compliance: SOC2 in place, need KMS + audit logs.
- Quote: 'We can't have agents waiting 1s per call - aim for <500ms p95.' - Head of Product
- Next: run POC, then sizing + pricing for Dedicated (3 reserved GPUs), legal review on data residency.
poi_notes: Head of Product (Sonia Patel) and Engineering Manager (Marco Ruiz) are the primary champions. Product is hands-on: wants to validate streaming + tool-calls end-to-end. Finance is conservative on ARR commit; will need clear TCO vs current webhook-based flows.
eng_notes: SE (Priya) to deliver architecture doc: hosted API streaming + function-calling to trigger Stripe/Zuora, JSON schema validation, retry/backoff for tool calls, observability hooks for per-route latency and token counts.
success_criteria: POC success = p95 latency <500ms for agent flows, >=95% successful tool call execution, structured JSON passes schema validation for >98% of transactions, preliminary cost estimate within target range.
acceptance_risks: Legal on data residency, long-term cost at scale, integration complexity with legacy billing connectors in Zuora.
